Manage server deployments, upgrades, patching, performance tuning, backups, and system lifecycle activities. Troubleshoot complex operating system, application, authentication, networking, and performance issues. Monitor system health, capacity, availability, and resource utilization. Implement configuration changes and maintain system documentation in accordance with established procedures. Support enterprise services, applications, and infrastructure across geographically dispersed shore and maritime environments. Administer standalone and clustered SQL Server instances supporting enterprise applications. Design, implement, maintain, and validate High Availability/Disaster Recovery (HA/DR) solutions. Develop and maintain automated database backup, restore, and recovery procedures. Monitor database performance, capacity, availability, and resource utilization. Analyze query execution plans and resolve blocking, deadlocks, inefficient queries, and other database performance issues. Optimize database queries, storage allocation, and configuration to maintain operational performance and reliability. Network Monitoring Service / SolarWinds Administration Administer, configure, maintain, and optimize the enterprise Network Monitoring Service (NMS) platform, currently SolarWinds. Monitor the health and performance of Windows servers, network devices, IIS applications, SQL databases, and other mission-critical systems. Support Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements and activities necessary to maintain system authorization and accreditation. Maintain secure configurations and ensure systems remain compliant with applicable DoD cybersecurity requirements. Identify potential security weaknesses and implement corrective actions in coordination with appropriate stakeholders. Automation & Scripting Develop and maintain PowerShell and T-SQL scripts to automate administrative and operational tasks. Automate system configuration, monitoring, reporting, maintenance, log analysis, and scheduled activities. Develop custom scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce repetitive administrative tasks. Troubleshoot and modify existing automation scripts as required. Technical Support & Operations Provide advanced technical support for enterprise infrastructure, applications, and database services. Serve as a senior technical resource for troubleshooting complex or recurring infrastructure issues. Participate in incident response, problem management, system recovery, and root-cause analysis. Coordinate with network, cybersecurity, application, database, and systems engineering teams to resolve cross-functional issues. Maintain accurate technical documentation, system configurations, operational procedures, and troubleshooting records. Support planned maintenance, system upgrades, deployments, and infrastructure modernization efforts. Perform other duties as assigned in support of mission requirements. Required Qualifications High school diploma or equivalent. Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience administering enterprise Windows Server environments. Demonstrated expertise with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022. Advanced experience administering Microsoft IIS in an enterprise environment. Advanced experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft SQL Server 2016/2019/2022. Experience administering enterprise network monitoring platforms, preferably SolarWinds. Strong proficiency with PowerShell and T-SQL. Experience with server hardening, vulnerability remediation, and DISA STIG compliance. Experience troubleshooting complex Windows, IIS, SQL Server, networking, authentication, and application issues. Experience supporting geographically distributed enterprise environments. Strong technical documentation, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple technical priorities in a mission-critical environment. Certification Requirements Must meet applicable DoD 8570.01-M / DoD 8140 baseline requirements for IAT Level II , including: CompTIA Security+ CE , or An equivalent DoD-approved cybersecurity certification.
